summary: Lock camera pitch — orbit into depth is the remaining seasick cause
description: Bug: even with a planar graph, OrbitControls let the camera pitch. zoomToFit and drag tilt the view so the xy plane is seen on edge; nodes then stack in screen-depth and the user feels motion-sick. Lock minPolarAngle and maxPolarAngle to Math.PI / 2 so the camera stays face-on. Keep zoom and pan. Do not enable autoRotate.
scope: After ForceGraph3D is created, set controls minPolarAngle and maxPolarAngle to Math.PI / 2
acceptanceCriteria: viewer.js contains minPolarAngle, maxPolarAngle, and Math.PI / 2.
